Did you know?

  • Tyranids is also referenced as Tyranid, Hive Fleets.
  • Evidence around Tyranids is classified as fiction on Ton-o-Lore.
page.overview:
What is Tyranids?

Tyranids are a ravenous alien swarm guided by the Hive Mind, stripping worlds of life to fuel further invasion of the galaxy.

Also known as: Tyranid, Hive Fleets.
